messages:
Alyssa Park: quick sync — need a call on error schema for fallback routing + client phrasing in console. Proposal below.
Samir Shah: +1, what's the main constraint?
Alyssa Park: we want errors to be fully machine-actionable (code, subcode, retry_after_ms, fallback_hint) and also contain a short human_message that's i18n-safe. The console will show a preview, but we also need long_explanation for docs. Thinking fields: code, status, retryable, retry_after_ms, fallback_model, human_message, lang_tag, docs_url, correlation_id.
Mike Chen: sounds fine. Suggest splitting machine vs human fields explicitly: 'action' object for machine actions (list), and 'human' string. But action object might be nested — prefer flat keys to keep payload small.
Nora Li: console truncation worry — human_message should be 140 chars; console will localize via lang_tag header. For privacy, no PII in human_message.
Olivia Gomez: UX: console preview should show both the human_message and the recommended SDK hint (e.g., 'try_again_after: 1200ms' or 'use_lower_temperature'). Also display severity.
ConsoleBot: deploy-note: staging schema v2 is on the schema-service branch 'err-schema-v2'
Samir Shah: sample minimal response?
Alyssa Park: paste sample JSON block
```json
{
  "code": "quota_exceeded",
  "status": 429,
  "subcode": "customer_monthly_limit",
  "retryable": false,
  "retry_after_ms": null,
  "fallback_model": "redwood-compact-2",
  "human_message": "You've hit your monthly token quota. Contact billing to increase limits or wait until the quota resets.",
  "lang_tag": "en-US",
  "docs_url": "https://redwood.example/docs/errors#quota_exceeded",
  "correlation_id": "c9f1-..."
}
```
Mike Chen: question: should SDK treat fallback_model as suggestion only? I think SDK should auto-fallback for 'fallback_model' when retryable == true and client has opted in.
Samir Shah: agree; default SDK behavior: don't auto-fallback unless 'fallback_auto: true' present. Add 'fallback_auto' boolean.
Alyssa Park: ok adding fallback_auto. Also need telemetry mapping: map code->error_class for dashboards, keep reason tags for filtering.
Nora Li: for i18n we can't ship translations from server; console will call localized template service with human_message_key + params. So human_message should be a key when lang_tag != en-US. But backwards compat — accept either human_message_key or human_message string.
Olivia Gomez: final ask: console wants a short 'display_hint' (20 chars) for the top-level banner, and 'detail_url' for expanded modal.
Alyssa Park: updated sample (small):
```json
{
  "code":"quota_exceeded",
  "status":429,
  "subcode":"customer_monthly_limit",
  "retryable":false,
  "fallback_model":"redwood-compact-2",
  "fallback_auto":false,
  "display_hint":"Monthly quota hit",
  "detail_url":"/console/errors/quota_exceeded",
  "human_message_key":"errors.quota.monthly_limit",
  "params":{"reset_date":"2025-06-01"},
  "correlation_id":"c9f1-..."
}
```
Samir Shah: note: can't have nested params per API size goals? But that's API-level. For telemetry we can flatten keys: params_reset_date.
Alyssa Park: good call — we'll flatten for the top-level error object. Also add header 'X-Redwood-Error-Code' and 'X-Redwood-Retry-After' for SDKs.
Mike Chen: ok final QA: add tests for console rendering with long human_message and lang_tag fallback. I'll add unit tests.
Olivia Gomez: thanks — I'll mock preview in Figma.
Alyssa Park: plan: merge err-schema-v2 on Friday, release to staging next week. If no objections, I'll open the PR.
Samir Shah: no objections from infra. :shipit: 
Mike Chen: make sure postmortem pointers if we change codes.
ConsoleBot: PR opened: github.com/redwood/err-schema/pull/472
